findings.text: The added assertion `assert self.header is not None` will crash when rendering a table without a header row (e.g., malformed markdown or HTML table with only tbody); the code previously would have failed later with a clearer AttributeError or handled the None case.

The added assertion `assert self.body is not None` will crash when rendering a table with a header but no body rows; the original code would have simply yielded an empty table or failed more gracefully.
